blocks.text: Low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum compound ke structure ke baare mein teen ahem maloomat deta hai: molecule mein protons ke kitne different environments hain, yeh environments kis qism ke hain, aur har environment mein protons ka relative (nisbati) number kya hai. ¹H NMR spectrum ko interpret karte (samajhte) waqt teen parameters ghaur se dekhe jate hain: spectrum mein peaks ka total number, har peak ki position (chemical shift δ), aur har peak ke neeche ka area.

blocks.title: Number of peaks (peaks ki ginti)
blocks.text: ¹H NMR spectrum mein peaks ka number molecule mein protons ke different chemical environments ke number ke barabar hota hai.
Spectrum ki har peak aik alag chemical environment ko represent karti (dikhati) hai.

blocks.alt: Low-resolution spectrum: absorption of energy versus delta ppm, 7.0 se 0.0. Teen broad (chaudi) peaks: a (1H) taqreeban 5.4, b (2H) taqreeban 3.7, c (3H, sab se lambi) taqreeban 1.2, aur 0.0 par TMS ki chhoti peak. Inset mein ethanol: CH3 ke Hc aur CH2 ke Hb boxes mein, O-H ka Ha circle (daire) mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.4: Ethanol ka low-resolution 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.4 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen peaks = teen environments. Peak a (O-H, 5.4 ppm) sab se chhoti, b (CH₂, 3.7 ppm) beech wali aur c (CH₃, 1.2 ppm) sab se bari hai: areas 1:2:3, jo har group ke protons ka number hai. Structure par boxes aur circle ke rang peaks ke letters (a, b, c) se milte hain.

Figure 30.4 mein ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) ka low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum dikhaya gaya hai. Is mein teen peaks hain, yani ethanol mein protons ke teen different environments hain: CH₃ protons, CH₂ protons aur OH proton.

blocks.title: Peak ki chemical shift
blocks.text: Har peak ki chemical shift batati hai ke woh peak dene wale protons ka chemical environment kis qism ka hai.

Environment ki qism chemical shifts ko standard values (Table 30.1) se compare kar ke pehchani jati hai. Ethanol ke spectrum (Figure 30.4) mein 5.4 ppm wali peak kam electron density wale environment (OH) ki hai. 3.7 ppm wali peak oxygen ke saath jure –CH₂– ki hai, aur 1.2 ppm wala signal methyl group (–CH₃ protons) ka hai.
Har peak ke neeche ka area us peak ko dene wale protons ke number ke proportional (usi nisbat mein) hota hai.

Ethanol ke ¹H NMR spectrum (Figure 30.4) mein peaks par 1H, 2H aur 3H likha hai, yani peaks ke relative areas 1:2:3 ke ratio mein hain. Yeh har environment ke protons ke number se milta hai: -OH mein 1, –CH₂ mein 2 aur –CH₃ mein 3 protons. Is spectrum se pata chalta hai ke protons ke teen qism ke environments hain, is liye teen signals aate hain, aur intensity ka ratio 1:2:3 hai. Har qism ke protons ka number jorne se molecule ke total protons milte hain: ethanol mein total 6 hydrogen atoms (1 + 2 + 3) hain.

blocks.prompt: a) ¹H NMR spectrum mein signals ka number kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Molecule mein protons ke different chemical environments ka number.

blocks.prompt: b) In molecules ke ¹H NMR spectra mein kitni peaks aayengi? (i) 1,1,2,2-dichloroethane (ii) butane (iii) propan-2-ol (iv) pentan-3-one (v) benzene
blocks.explanation: (i) 1 (neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhein); (ii) 2 (CH₃ aur CH₂); (iii) 3 (CH₃, CH, OH); (iv) 2 (do aik jaise ethyl groups ke CH₃ aur CH₂); (v) 1.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ‘1,1,2,2-dichloroethane’ chhapa hai. Yeh naam mumkin nahi: chaar locants (1,1,2,2) ke liye chaar chlorine chahiye, yani 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane, Cl₂CH–CHCl₂. Agar 1,2-dichloroethane, ClCH₂–CH₂Cl, matlab tha to bhi jawab aik hi hai: tamam protons barabar (equivalent) hain, sirf aik environment.

blocks.prompt: c) Bromoethane (CH₃-CH₂-Br) ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein kitni peaks aur kin chemical shifts par?
blocks.explanation: Do peaks: Br ke saath CH₂, 3.0 – 4.5 ppm (area 2), aur CH₃, alkyl, 0.5 – 1.5 ppm (area 3).

blocks.prompt: d) 2-chlorobutane ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein kitne signals aayenge? Structure bana kar batayein ke kis hydrogen ki chemical shift sab se zyada hogi.
blocks.explanation: Structure CH₃–CHCl–CH₂–CH₃ hai; chaar environments, is liye chaar signals. C2 par jura akela H, jo chlorine wale carbon par hai, sab se zyada chemical shift (3.0 – 4.5 ppm) dikhayega.

blocks.prompt: e) ¹H NMR mein peak ka area kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Us environment mein protons ka relative (nisbati) number.

items: Peaks ka number = protons ke environments ka number.
Chemical shift = environment ki qism (Table 30.1); area = protons ka relative number.
